> Dear ggplot group,
>
> I am trying to add annotation (text and arrows, although so far only tried with text) to only the uppermost facet panel but do not seem to be able to do it. I have searched online, read widely about creating a separate df that contains the x/y coordinates for the text, but on copying the examples I get various error messages.

> p + facet_grid(sample ~., scales = "free")

> titre=c(80, 80, 80),

> Text=c("P", "B", "C"))

> Felix

messages.subject: Re: annotate selected facets
parts:
ggplot(data=df, aes(x=week, y = titre)) +
geom_point(aes(colour = Group)) +
geom_line(aes(colour = Group)) +
geom_text(aes(week, titre, label=Text), data=nd) +
facet_wrap(~ sample, scales = "free", ncol = 1)

Dennis
